info.title: ESPHEA API
info.summary: Configure, run and inspect evolutionary multi-objective experiments.

get.description: Problems and algorithms available, with default parameters.

post.description: Validate a configuration and return the quantities derived from it.

schema.title: Response List Experiments Api Experiments Get

get.description: Median and quartiles of each indicator across runs, per generation.

schema.title: Response Get Experiment Metrics Api Experiments  Experiment Id  Metrics Get

get.description: Parent pool, offspring (with lineage) and survival outcome of a stored generation.

schema.title: Response List Analyses Api Runs  Run Id  Analyses Get

post.description: Queue an analysis (``topology`` or ``zigzag``) of a finished run.

get.description: Analyses of every run of an experiment (batches share a ``batch_id``).

schema.title: Response List Experiment Analyses Api Experiments  Experiment Id  Analyses Get

post.description: Queue the same analysis for every finished run of an experiment, as one batch.

schema.title: Response Create Analysis Batch Api Experiments  Experiment Id  Analyses Post

get.description: Scale statistics of the run's point clouds to choose ``max_epsilon``.
Per-generation summaries and distances (to the previous and to the final generation).
Betti numbers per generation over the scale grid ``0..max_epsilon``.
The population at ``step`` and the representative cycle of ``bar`` there.
Median and quartiles across the runs of a batch, per generation.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: Alive at max_epsilon (death capped at it).

values.title: Values
values.description: values[i][j]: Betti number at generation i, scale j.

CatalogOut.title: CatalogOut
CatalogOut.description: Available components with their default parameters.

suggested_scales.title: Suggested Scales
suggested_scales.description: Fixed scales for a zigzag: multiples of the population's spacing.

ExperimentPreviewOut.title: ExperimentPreviewOut
ExperimentPreviewOut.description: Quantities derived from a configuration, shown while it is being edited.

reference_front_size.title: Reference Front Size
reference_front_size.description: Points sampled from the true front.

n_partitions.title: N Partitions
n_partitions.description: Das-Dennis partitions (p) of the unit simplex.

pop_size.title: Pop Size
pop_size.description: Null means the smallest multiple of 4 not below the number of directions.

points.title: Points
points.description: Null when the front is unknown.

attempt.title: Attempt
attempt.description: Execution attempt (0 = not started; >1 after recovery).

decision_variables.title: Decision Variables
decision_variables.description: Also store X (objectives F are always stored).

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Rank in this generation's survival; -1 if discarded.

parents.title: Parents
parents.description: Indices into the population; -1 if none.

point_cloud.description: Which individuals of each stored generation form the point cloud.

normalization.description: Scaling of the objective space before computing distances.

max_epsilon.title: Max Epsilon
max_epsilon.description: Largest edge length of the Vietoris-Rips filtration (scale 0..max_epsilon).

distance_matrix.title: Distance Matrix
distance_matrix.description: Also compute distances between all pairs of (up to 100) generations.

TopologyAnalysisConfig.title: TopologyAnalysisConfig
TopologyAnalysisConfig.description: Vietoris-Rips persistence of every stored generation, and distances between them.

max_finite_death.title: Max Finite Death
max_finite_death.description: Largest death of a feature not alive at max_epsilon, over all generations.

epsilons.title: Epsilons
epsilons.description: Fixed scales (edge lengths); one zigzag barcode per scale.

normalization.description: 'none' or 'ideal_nadir' (a per-generation scaling would break the inclusions).

representatives.title: Representatives
representatives.description: Longest bars per dimension and scale whose representative cycles are kept.

ZigzagAnalysisConfig.title: ZigzagAnalysisConfig
ZigzagAnalysisConfig.description: Zigzag persistence of P_{t-1} -> R_t <- P_t at fixed Vietoris-Rips scales.

representatives_skipped.title: Representatives Skipped
representatives_skipped.description: Why representatives were not extracted at this scale (null otherwise).

representative.title: Representative
representative.description: Representative available (true), unavailable (false) or not kept (null).

ZigzagBarsOut.title: ZigzagBarsOut
ZigzagBarsOut.description: Bars alive on steps [birth, death - 1]; step 2t is P_t and step 2t - 1 is R_t.

ZigzagEventsOut.title: ZigzagEventsOut
ZigzagEventsOut.description: Per generation t: Betti numbers at P_t and R_t, births and deaths by cause.
